snippet.title: Fakin' It XL | Official Trailer | Available Now!
snippet.description:
Fakin' It XL is out now! https://www.jackboxgames.com/games/fakin-it-xl

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5054700/Fakin_It_XL/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10020868
Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/fakin-it-xl-switch/
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/fakin-it-xl/9ph4vwpw7q6w

Fakin’ It XL is bringing good, (mostly) clean, lying fun to your next game night! 

One player, the Faker, never gets the prompt and has to bluff their way through. Choose in-room or remote play up front and get round types built for either. New content, new lies, same party hit. 

Learn more about Fakin' It XL on our blog: https://www.jackboxgames.com/blog
